phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M16A1 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.56×45mm NATO (M193) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 380 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 380 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 508 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 990 m/s (1745 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Gas Tube Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, direct gas tube vents propellant pressure into the internal carrier piston to rotate the multi-lug bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M16A1 staged for its 700–950 RPM cyclic · inline recoil geometry cadence.

zh.headline: 柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪：1967 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 尤金·斯通纳开创的 M16A1 将航空 7075-T6 铝合金上下机匣、同轴直线缓冲托与枪机框内气缸膨胀结构融为一体，以不足 2.9 kg 的惊人空枪重量引爆了全球小口径高速轻量化步枪革命。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M16A1 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1967 年问世的 柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪 由美国柯尔特制造公司（Colt）主导研制，定位为经典的突击步枪。1967 年定型的 M16A1 在吸取越战初期弹药改粉与缺镀铬教训后全面镀铬内膛并下发清洁套件，奠定了 AR-15 平台绵延六十余年的模块化生命力。
尤金·斯通纳开创的 M16A1 将航空 7075-T6 铝合金上下机匣、同轴直线缓冲托与枪机框内气缸膨胀结构融为一体，以不足 2.9 kg 的惊人空枪重量引爆了全球小口径高速轻量化步枪革命。 整件装备总长 986 mm（20 in 枪管 · 固定枪托）、空重 2.89 kg，成为同期突击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1967 年，美国柯尔特制造公司（Colt）推出了划时代的柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪。1967 年定型的 M16A1 在吸取越战初期弹药改粉与缺镀铬教训后全面镀铬内膛并下发清洁套件，奠定了 AR-15 平台绵延六十余年的模块化生命力。 它的核心设计聚焦于同轴直线枪托与 29 mm 极低膛轴线将后坐力直导肩窝，大幅抑制枪口上跳，奠定了其在突击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「斯通纳直推导气管（机框内膨胀活塞）· 7 突笋回转枪机」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，导气管将高压火药燃气直引机框内气室，推动多突笋枪机旋转开锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。枪机框内膨胀气缸取代前部重型活塞杆，减轻重心前坠并提升精度，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪 采用斯通纳直推导气管（机框内膨胀活塞）· 7 突笋回转枪机。在每个击发周期中，导气管将高压火药燃气直引机框内气室，推动多突笋枪机旋转开锁。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了枪机框内膨胀气缸取代前部重型活塞杆，减轻重心前坠并提升精度。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.56×45mm NATO (M193) 弹药规格与 508 mm 轻型铅笔轮廓镀铬枪管（6 条右旋 · 305 mm / 1:12 缠距），最高工作膛压约 380 MPa，可赋予弹头 990 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,745 J 动能，有效作用距离达 460 米。
内膛技术特点方面，1:12 慢缠距匹配 55 gr M193 轻弹头，20 in 长管榨出近 990 m/s 极高初速。同时，新增右侧枪机辅助推柄、全镀铬枪膛与鸟笼式消焰器彻底扭转早期口碑，令其在 700–950 发/分（全自动）· 直线后坐布局 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 508 毫米身管与 5.56×45mm NATO (M193) 口径，柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪 实现了每秒 990 米的初速与 460 米有效射程。1:12 慢缠距匹配 55 gr M193 轻弹头，20 in 长管榨出近 990 m/s 极高初速，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 29 mm 膛轴设计，柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.8 N·s 水平。标志性三角形玻璃钢护木与一体式提把觇孔照门构成冷战经典轮廓。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-37）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，标志性三角形玻璃钢护木与一体式提把觇孔照门构成冷战经典轮廓。欢迎在 BAY-37 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 柯尔特 M16A1 轻量化突击步枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Colt M16A1: The 1967 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Eugene Stoner’s M16A1 united aircraft-grade 7075-T6 aluminum receivers, an inline stock buffer, and an internal bolt-carrier gas piston at just 2.89 kg, sparking the global small-caliber high-velocity infantry revolution. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-37.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M16A1
paragraphs: Introduced in 1967 by Colt’s Manufacturing Company in United States, the Colt M16A1 emerged as a defining Assault Rifle. Standardized in 1967 with chrome-lined bores, forward assist, and revised propellant specs, the M16A1 cured early Vietnam-era teething issues and launched the 60-year modular AR lineage.

Eugene Stoner’s M16A1 united aircraft-grade 7075-T6 aluminum receivers, an inline stock buffer, and an internal bolt-carrier gas piston at just 2.89 kg, sparking the global small-caliber high-velocity infantry revolution. Measuring 986 mm (20 in Barrel · Fixed Rifle Stock) at an unloaded weight of 2.89 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1967, Colt’s Manufacturing Company of United States introduced the Colt M16A1. Standardized in 1967 with chrome-lined bores, forward assist, and revised propellant specs, the M16A1 cured early Vietnam-era teething issues and launched the 60-year modular AR lineage. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Straight-line stock and 29 mm low bore axis channel recoil directly into the shoulder — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Colt M16A1 sits its Stoner Internal-Piston Direct Impingement · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt & Inline Buffer. Throughout every firing cycle, direct gas tube vents propellant pressure into the internal carrier piston to rotate the multi-lug bolt, containing 380 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Internal carrier expansion chamber eliminates heavy front piston mass for agile balance, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Colt M16A1 relies on Stoner Internal-Piston Direct Impingement · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt & Inline Buffer. During each cycle, direct gas tube vents propellant pressure into the internal carrier piston to rotate the multi-lug bolt. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Internal carrier expansion chamber eliminates heavy front piston mass for agile balance.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.56×45mm NATO (M193) with 508 mm Lightweight Chrome-Lined Barrel (6-Groove RH · 1:12" Twist), the Colt M16A1 develops 990 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,745 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 460 meters.

Internally, 1:12" rifling stabilizes 55 gr M193 ball while the 20-inch bore extracts ~990 m/s muzzle velocity. Combined with its 700–950 RPM cyclic · inline recoil geometry tempo, Added forward assist, full chrome-lined bore/chamber, and A1 birdcage flash hider, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.56×45mm NATO (M193) through its 508 millimeter bore, the Colt M16A1 achieves 990 meters per second and 460 meters of effective reach. 1:12" rifling stabilizes 55 gr M193 ball while the 20-inch bore extracts ~990 m/s muzzle velocity.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with a 29 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4.8 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Signature triangular fiberglass handguard and integral carry-handle aperture sight.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-37), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Signature triangular fiberglass handguard and integral carry-handle aperture sight. Explore BAY-37 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Colt M16A1.
